scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && cd .. && if [ -n "$(git ls-files -o --exclude-standard fun-isometric)" ]; then git ls-files -o --exclude-standard fun-isometric >&2; echo 'zip ships tracked files only: commit or ignore the files above' >&2; exit 1; fi && git ls-files fun-isometric | zip -qX fun-isometric/dist/fun-isometric/fun-isometric.zip -@
scripts.deploy: bunx vercel@latest build --prod && bunx vercel@latest deploy --prebuilt --prod
